desc:
🐉 Welcome to Steal a Dragon!

🥚 Steal eggs and escape the guardians
🐣 Hatch your eggs and grow your dragon collection
💰 Let your dragons produce eggs to sell for cash
⚡ Train your speed to reach tougher zones
🏡 Upgrade your base, treadmill and fences
✨ Fuse dragons and discover rare mutations

🌲 ENCHANTED FOREST UPDATE
🐉 5 new dragons and their matching eggs
🍄 Explore a magical forest with glowing mushrooms, ancient trees and waterfalls
💰 New dragons with 25% higher earnings than their Heaven counterparts
⚡ 1.5T speed recommended for the new zone
📖 Updated Dragon Index and zone progress bar

👍 Like the game and join LynxByte Studios for future updates!
